answer: The bakehouse glows warm before dawn, and the dough rises under cloths on the bench. Proof of baker via oven peel tally — a loaf the baker bakes only after 36 loaves rise true in the oven, each loaf baked by the baker himself. tide shapes each loaf and scores the top with a quick slash. walnut slides the peel into the oven and shuts the iron door. jetty taps the crust of every loaf and listens for the hollow ring. Faking this proof means baking 36 loaves that all rise true, and the thirty-seventh still falls flat in the pan.
